note: Jenkins County (13165) has no queryable zoning district layer. Millen, the only incorporated city, has a zoning ordinance but its official zoning map is kept on file with the zoning administrator, not published as a service. The county's qPublic viewer lists parcels, commissioner districts, roads and flood maps, but no zoning. ArcGIS search for Jenkins zoning returned nothing. The 2010-2015 comprehensive plan update says zoning was largely absent in the county.
